## 📋 Checklist Before Merge

Please ensure the following are completed before submitting:

- [ ] Ran `make release-check` locally — all checks pass ✅
- [ ] Added or updated related demos in `frontend/src/pages/`
- [ ] Confirmed styling matches Tailwind standards and responsive behavior
- [ ] Tested in **light mode** and **dark mode**
- [ ] If UI was updated, added **before/after screenshots or a screen recording**
